pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 67 degrees, relative humidity 62 percent, barometer 30.07 inches, adjusted
altitude 2,277 feet, track temperature 98 degrees.

Tony Stewart is 35 - 15 in Rd. 1 overall and 9 - 3 this year.  Josh Hart is 1 - 2 against Stewart this year.

Stewart and Hart have each won 3 times against the other in prior events. 

Stewart with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  Stewart with his quickest pass of the
weekend for the win.

Leah Pruett is 11 - 1 in Rd. 1 this year.  Will Smith lost to Pruett in Rd. 1 in Seattle.

Pruett is 3 - 0 against Smith in prior events. 

Pruett with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  Pruett with her quickest pass this
season and her career best speed.  She had the big top end speed to make her first 340 mph pass.  Leah
Pruett's incremental times: 60ft-0.836 sec., 330ft-2.123, 660ft-2.982/296.50 mph. 

Smith makes his career best pass in the losing effort.

Billy Torrence wins 84% of his Rd. 1 races when he has lane choice.  Clay Millican is 3 - 1 against Torrence
in Rd. 1. Their last Rd. 1 meeting was Las Vegas, 2024.

Millican is 6 - 5 against Torrence in prior events. 

Torrence goes red to give Millican the freebie.  Torrence makes his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing
effort.

Millican kept it hooked up and his quickest pass of the weekend for the win.

This is the first time Gordon and Palmer have faced each other in eliminations.

Gordon with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  She will give up lane choice to
Stewart in the next round.

Palmer is dropping cylinders right at the hit and then starts to spin the tires and clicked it off.

Doug Kalitta is the only Pro driver this year to be 12 - 0 in Rd. 1.  The last time the #16 TF qualifier won a
round here was 2007.

Kalitta is 3 - 0 against Ferre in prior events. 

Kalitta with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.

Ferre with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

Shawn Langdon has qualified in the top half of the field at 25 of his last 30 races.   Keith Murt is making
his 7th start.

This is the first time Langdon and Murt have faced each other in eliminations. 

Murt with a great light, but Langdon had the difference made up by the time they go by the Christmas tree and
never trailed from there on for the win.  Langdon with his quickest pass of the weekend for the win, he will
give up lane choice to Pruett in the next round.

In his last 5 races Justin Ashley is 1 -4 in Rd.  Shawn Reed is 2 - 9 in Rd. 1 this year.

Ashley is 2 - 0 against Reed in prior events. 

Ashley with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  Ashley will have lane choice over
Millican in the next round.

Reed is dropping cylinders right at the hit and clicked it off.

Antron Brown's 83 rounds against Schumacher are the 2nd most for him against any opponent (D. Kalitta - 84).
In their 82 races Tony Schumacher has "left first" 22 times.

Brown is 47 - 35 against Schumacher in prior events. 

Schumacher with the starting line advantage and then attempted to drive through tire smoke and got real loose
before he clicked it off.

Brown starts using up his engine on the top end, but still gets the win.  He will give up lane choice to
Kalitta in the next round.
